finding: The audited open observations do not determine whether eight hollow shafts end 648 m beneath Khafre.
scope: Eight vertical shaft interiors only. Spiral paths and terminal chambers have different unknown mass contrasts and are not included. Depth is relative to a horizontal base plane.
replay: python3 ground_test.py > reproduced.json (Python 3 plus NumPy). Compare parsed JSON numerically. Run in this directory.

actual_field_data.distance_method: Great-circle on sphere of mean radius 6371008.8 m. Approximate given historical horizontal datum and catalog center.
actual_field_data.height_note: 69 m above sea level is an approximate Khafre base elevation (Nell and Ruggles table 12). A flat local Cartesian forward model is sufficient at this scale.
actual_field_data.bound: G times total mass deficit divided by squared minimum horizontal distance. Conservative in the local plane and independent of station height.
actual_field_data.uncertainty: Station uncertainty and occupation date unavailable. Decimal reporting is not an uncertainty estimate.

engsn97_giza_city.interpretation: Even if all other gravity contributions were perfectly predicted, this station alone lacks sensitivity to the benchmark at its published precision. This is a sensitivity comparison, not a residual fit.

actual_field_data.inference: Neither the absolute value nor the two reported anomalies are a no-shaft baseline. Removing regional geology cannot be calibrated with one distant observation.

acoustic_timing.emitted_acoustic_pulse: Several cycles due to ringing. Section IV.D.4 describes about 8 m of pulse including ringing in the 33 m echo discussion.
acoustic_timing.figure_93: Pooled picked ranges, axis ticks from 5 to 40 m. No per-station time trace. Plotted full trace duration unknown.
acoustic_timing.meaning: 432 ms is a travel-time comparison only. The 100 ms repetition interval does not give the total recorded time or usable listening window. The stated long-range application and published picks establish no sensitivity to a 648 m reflector. A slant range from the floor is not a surveyed depth below the base.

model.coordinates: Local x east, y north from catalog Khafre center. z depth positive downward. Positive gravity is down. All listed model stations lie on the base plane unless marked otherwise.
model.claimed_geometry: Eight wells in two parallel north-south rows ending at 648 m. A March presentation assumes 20 m tube diameter. Neither the slide nor the later interview establishes the internal void diameter.
model.assumptions: Eight entire circular interiors, model radius 10 m, roof at 50 m, 40 m spacings in both directions. Unmeasured. All model points are hypothetical. Central points require access in or under the pyramid; perimeter proxy is about 110 m east of center.
model.kernel: g_z = G (rho_fill - rho_host) integral_over_disk [1/sqrt(s^2+t^2) - 1/sqrt(s^2+b^2)] dA. s is lateral distance to each area element. Sum eight bodies. Homogeneous reference has zero perturbation.
model.sweep_note: One-at-a-time deterministic sensitivity cases, not field data, confidence intervals or bounds on actual geology. Gross column diameter could also enclose a much narrower void.

diagram_geometry_sensitivity.geometry: Only the eight horizontal centers change. At each side compare a base-level station 110 m from the center to one 1 km away on the same ray.
diagram_geometry_sensitivity.meaning: Assumed roofs, measured drawing positions, unknown physical shaft locations. Signs and numbers are predictions for this diagram. The four values span sides, not statistical uncertainty.

equal_east_pair_alternative.interpretation: Deterministic pair-matched model with the same eight axes and density. Radius was fitted to the 648 m scenario only, not to observations. Independent station geometry can help separate the alternatives.

depth_discrimination.bound_formula: For each area element at depth z and any horizontal offset s, z/(s^2+z^2)^(3/2) <= 1/z^2. Integrate z=600..648 over the total void area. Valid at or above the assumed base plane, given the radius and contrast.
depth_discrimination.scaling: Bound scales with inner radius squared and absolute density contrast. Does not include moving or adding any terminal chambers. A weaker contrast makes the endpoint still harder to resolve.

design.pair: (110 m east, 0 north) minus (1 km east, 0 north), idealized common elevation. The physical controls would need surveyed elevations, topography and monument geometry.
design.example_spacing_m: 5-10 m along multiple accessible sides, plus independent surrounding control lines and any accessible interior stations. Check injection recovery for actual station geometry before interpreting a null.
design.uncertainty: The assumed 10 microgal one-sigma error is for the final contrast, including covariance, residual leveling, monument mass, terrain, groundwater, variable rock density and regional background. It is a design goal, not achieved precision. Reject a fixed model only if measured contrast disagrees beyond a justified uncertainty threshold, with a background fitted from independent controls.
design.height: A 1 cm relative height error gives about 3.086 microgal in the nominal free-air term before terrain and local-gradient effects. Estimate the local gradient, repeat base ties, correct tides and drift, level instrument heights, propagate correlated errors.
design.geometry: A single gravity low cannot determine eight cylinders or their bottoms. Natural karst, lithology and backfill can have the same integrated mass deficit. Publish predicted axes, inner radii, roofs/fill, station coordinates, timestamps, raw readings, repeats, all reductions and covariance. A depth-resolved independent method or directly sampled intersection is needed to assign geometry.
